title: Finite simultaneous descent of differentials of constant sheaf terms
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, T an object, and B a commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let P be a cochain complex of B-module sheaves on C/T [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose integers a,b and a family of finitely generated B-modules M^q [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] are given, with M^q=0 for q<a or b<q and isomorphisms P^q = constant(M^q) [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] for every q. Then there is a J-covering sieve S on T such that for every f:U -> T in S there is an actual cochain complex N of finite B-modules, zero outside [a,b], and a chain isomorphism P|U = constant(N). No Noetherian, points, terminal-object-of-C, or nonempty-interval hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: Use the canonical restriction isomorphisms for constant sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-site-constant-restriction], defined by restricting both from the ambient site. Their compatibility with the sheafification units, checked at the terminal object of a slice, identifies equality on generating constant sections with equality of sheaf morphisms by the constant-sheaf adjunction.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: Conjugate each differential P^q -> P^(q+1) by the supplied term isomorphisms. The local constant-morphism theorem [lem-weil-pbc-site-constant-morphism-local] supplies local module maps for every source degree q in [a,b]. Intersect the finitely many covering sieves on C/T and transport along the slice-sieve equivalence to obtain one covering sieve S on T [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. The section equalities and the unit compatibility of Step 1 give simultaneous sheaf-morphism equalities after restriction along every nonempty member of S.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: For a member f:U -> T with the empty sieve not covering U, the constant-sheaf functor on C/U is faithful. Indeed the unit of constant-presheaf sheafification at the terminal object is injective on this nonempty slice; naturality of the unit then reflects equality of module maps. This uses the proved local-equality argument for sheafification, implemented by GrothendieckTopology.toSheafify_const_app_injective, not an assumption that the site has points. Reflect the square-zero equality of consecutive restricted sheaf differentials to obtain square-zero for the lifted module maps. Outside [a,b] the source is zero, so take the zero map.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: The family M and these consecutive square-zero maps define an actual cochain complex N [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Its terms are exactly M^q, hence finite and zero outside [a,b]. The term isomorphisms commute with the differentials by construction and assemble to a chain isomorphism between restricted P and the constant complex of N.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: If the empty sieve covers U, every sheaf on C/U is zero: pull back that cover to every slice object and use the sheaf condition for the empty cover. Take the prescribed graded modules M with zero differentials. The term isomorphisms assemble to a chain isomorphism because every source sheaf is zero. This also handles an empty interval a>b and the zero ring.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_constant_complex_of_constant_terms
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
    (T : C) (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf (J.over T) (ModuleCat.{u} B)) ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ) (M : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} B)
    (hfinite : ∀ q, Module.Finite B (M q))
    (hzero : ∀ q, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero (M q))
    (e : ∀ q, P.X q ≅ (constantSheaf (J.over T) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj (M q)) :
    ∃ S ∈ J T, ∀ ⦃U : C⦄ (f : U ⟶ T), S f →
      ∃ N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} B) ℤ,
        (∀ q, Module.Finite B (N.X q)) ∧
        (∀ q, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero (N.X q)) ∧
        Nonempty (((J.overMapPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P ≅
          ((constantSheaf (J.over U) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)
